steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: Attach a spec sheet or a care guide to an estimate, and your client can download it.

steps.caption: Open the client
steps.narration: Open the client. Here, Halvorsen-Quist Properties, in San Antonio.

steps.caption: The estimate
steps.narration: Under Estimates, find the estimate the file belongs to.

steps.caption: Attach
steps.narration: Choose Attach, and pick the file. It can be a PDF or a picture.

steps.caption: Pinned to the estimate
steps.narration: The file is now pinned to this estimate. The bin beside it takes it off again.

steps.caption: The client's estimate
steps.narration: Now your client's screen, with the estimate open.

steps.caption: Attached documents
steps.narration: Below the estimate is a section called Attached documents, with your file.

steps.caption: Download
steps.narration: They choose Download to open it.

steps.caption: Back to the CRM
steps.narration: Back in the CRM, open the client again.

steps.caption: Logged under Activity
steps.narration: The client's Activity shows when the file was attached.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Attach is on each estimate, on the client's page under Clients.

youtube.title: How to attach files to an estimate | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Add a spec sheet, a care guide or a photo to an estimate in the ConstructHUB CRM. The file is pinned to that estimate and your client downloads it from the estimate page. Recorded in a demo workspace with a made-up client and a sample PDF.
